content: Preview environments (per-PR ephemeral namespaces via ApplicationSet PR generators) are valuable in teams but carry infra+process overhead; for a solo dev on a single node they're widely considered optional/deferred. Environment promotion (dev→staging→prod via kustomize overlays or separate branches/dirs) is the standard GitOps model but solo homelabs commonly run a single 'prod' env per app, adding a staging overlay only for risky apps. Codefresh/Octopus guidance: model environments as folders not branches.
